decisions.reason: The LED track spotlight builds directly on the firm's core lighting and track-system knowledge, and two years of dedicated web presence show the firm can interpret its results and refine it.
The LED ceiling luminaire is closely related to the firm's existing luminaire expertise and has been consistently presented on its own page, indicating stable commercial application.
The flexible LED spotlight extends known spotlight technology the firm already masters, so it can assimilate early feedback and improve it in-house despite only one year on the market.
The multi-outlet ceiling canopy is a complementary accessory that draws on the firm's installation and mounting knowledge and supports its luminaire range.
The low-voltage canopy fits the firm's electrical and low-voltage competence and is presented on a dedicated page, though as a niche variant it carries slightly higher risk.

The round glass track luminaires relate to the firm's track systems, but the glass design is less familiar and the product is only mentioned rather than featured, which makes its results harder to read; still, it is likely kept for another year.
